name: uswds-usage-report-theme
description: Sass build for the USWDS-themed docs/index.html report (not the Go CLI).

scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p docs/assets/uswds/fonts/public-sans docs/assets/uswds/fonts/roboto-mono docs/assets/uswds/img docs/assets/uswds/js && cp node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/fonts/public-sans/*.woff2 docs/assets/uswds/fonts/public-sans/ && cp node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/fonts/roboto-mono/*.woff2 docs/assets/uswds/fonts/roboto-mono/ && cp -r node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/img/usa-icons node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/img/usa-icons-bg docs/assets/uswds/img/ && cp node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/js/uswds-init.min.js node_modules/@uswds/uswds/dist/js/uswds.min.js docs/assets/uswds/js/
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:assets
